newsitem.title: ITALY: Venice airport 1996 cargo traffic up 14.8 percent.
newsitem.headline: Venice airport 1996 cargo traffic up 14.8 percent.

text.p: Cargo traffic handled by Venice airport last year totalled 13,807 tonnes, up 14.8 percent on the 1995 total, said the company responsible for its management, SAVE.

A total of 250 cargo flights were recorded by the airport in 1996 compared to none the previous year, while postal movements rose 18.5 percent to 504 and passengers handled increased 10.7 percent to 2.7 million.
SAVE has attributed the growth of Venice airport's cargo traffic to increased trade between Venice-based and eastern European companies, particularly in Romania.
